newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cheung Kong/Hutch win MTRC Tung Chung Package 3.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong/Hutch win MTRC Tung Chung Package 3.

text.p: The Mass Transit Railway Corp said on Tuesday the consortium comprising Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd and Hutchison Whampoa Ltd has won the tender for the Tung Chung Station Package Three development.

Tung Chung Station Package Three consists of 13 high-rise residential towers providing a maximum of 4,160 flats and five low-rise residential blocks with a maximum 150 flats, the Mass Transit Railway Corp (MTRC) said.

Also included is commercial accomodation of 5,000 square metres, 987 car parking spaces, a kindergarten and a covered market as well as landscaped open space and indoor recreational facilities, it said.
Financial details were not available, but local media have said the project is worth an estimated HK$11 billion, compared with the estimated HK$9 billion for phase two of the station development.

The MTRC said the Cheung Kong/Hutchison consortium had met all of its tender requirements and offered the best financial terms, adding it expected signing of the development agreement within the next few weeks.
Company officials were not available for comment.
The Tung Chung Station development will be located along Hong Kong's airport railway, which will link the territory's new Chek Lap Kok airport with the central urban areas.
The airport is due to be finished by April 1998 and the airport railway by June 1998.
